game_text: Unless Deep Hatred on table, deploy on table. Once per turn, may ▼ Blaster Rack or The Force Unleashed. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to deploy a character weapon (except Thermal Detonator) from Lost Pile. “Vader” on The Empire’s Back may be treated as “Galen.” {alter}
game_text_lines:
Unless Deep Hatred on table, deploy on table.
Once per turn, may ▼ Blaster Rack or The Force
Unleashed. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to deploy
a character weapon (except Thermal Detonator)
from Lost Pile. “Vader” on The Empire’s Back may be
treated as “Galen.” {alter}

Title bar: green Effect disc (as printed); '•Gift Of The Master'; destiny 4 (printed 5). LORE BOX: prints '“Give yourself to the dark side. It is the only way / you can save your friends.”' (first line indented) — same words as the printed lore → lore = printed lore; wiki has straight single quotes, the scan curly double quotes “…” → corrected. Right of the lore box: Death Star II ring (blue/red streak sphere), as printed; no Episode I. ART WINDOW blank white (also over the copyright margin) → printed art (Vader in the Emperor’s throne room). Banner 'EFFECT' (spaced caps), no grabber box → grabber false. Game text 6 lines — line 1 ends early ('…deploy on table.' then a new line 'Once per turn…'), a hard break kept in game_text_lines; '▼' inline (the stub expands it to 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'); curly “Vader” / “Galen.” and Empire’s; ends with the red circle-slash A = {alter} (stub: 'Immune to Alter.'). No icon column (only the diamond-17 set mark). Caption '•You Cannot Hide Forever (V)'. CHANGES vs printed card: title, destiny 5→4, game text replaced (printed: 'Deploy on table. Opponent’s Jedi are defense value -1. Never Tell Me The Odds is canceled. You may place Effect in Lost Pile to take one [Endor] or [Death Star II] Effect that deploys for free into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)'); disc, lore, ring, banner unchanged. Base page: bare 'You Cannot Hide Forever' = the DS2 Effect (the '(Dark)' page is the Reflections III Defensive Shield). Base scan only 350 px (DS2-D-youcannothideforever.gif); DS2 copyright by set (as vs16/32). Modern: VB4-D-giftofthemaster-pre.gif.
